summary: The duration side is covered: Macrostrat's international-intervals table gives eon boundaries (Phanerozoic base 538.8 Ma, Proterozoic 2500-538.8, Archean 4031-2500 as stored there) and PBDB's interval table has the same Phanerozoic base. The life side is thin: PBDB returns 2207 Ediacaran, 3954 Proterozoic and 26 Archean occurrence records, and no repository found holds biomarker records or any abundance measure matching 'swarmed'.
next_step: Pre-register the duration comparison on the Macrostrat/ICS boundary ages (aligning 'lowest Silurian' to the Cambrian base) and treat presence of life as the PBDB Precambrian occurrences; biomarkers and molecular-clock ages would need separate compilation.
obstacles_confirmed: 'Swarmed' has no abundance field in any dataset checked.
ICS chart is a JS app; no downloadable table was found on the fetched pages.
Pre-Cambrian occurrence counts are small relative to Phanerozoic.
